messages:
ci-bot: CI job #9845: premerge SAST scan failed on main — blocking merge. job: https://ci.redwood.dev/9845

maria-chen: saw this — deploy blocked. SAST flagged a high severity key disclosure in pkg/credentials.

maria-chen: relevant link to report: https://scans.redwood.dev/reports/9845

josh-keller: looking now. quick check — scanner logs show KMS decrypt errors when trying to fetch test fixtures.

josh-keller: paste of error from scanner-service logs:
```
2026-03-21T09:34:10Z ERROR decrypt failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = Request had insufficient authentication scopes.
caller=scanner-worker-3 pod=scanner-3
```

oliver-ng: that looks like the scanner service account lost roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on the key ring. we rotated a key binding in infra last night — could be related.

ashley: @oliver-ng do we have an audit entry showing the role revocation? need proof before we modify perms.

oliver-ng: checked audit logs: yes — 2026-03-20T23:02:11Z iam.setIamPolicy on projects/redwood-prod/serviceAccounts/scanner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com by infra-automation@ops.

maria-chen: but SAST flagged a literal-looking private key in code — could be FP if our test fixtures are encrypted and scanner tries to decrypt them at runtime and fails, then it greps the stub and reports it.

josh-keller: good point. reproduce steps I ran:
1) git checkout main
2) yarn test:scans --file pkg/credentials/testdata/fixture.enc
3) CLI calls gcloud KMS decrypt and hits PERMISSION_DENIED
4) scanner falls back to showing decrypted blob as candidate secret -> treated as a finding

ashley: TL;DR: root cause probably missing KMS decrypt perms for scanner SA -> scan tooling misclassifies encrypted blobs as cleartext -> false positive.

sec-oncall: recommend temporary mitigation to unblock merges: grant scanner-sa roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on the key ring for 2 hours, then rotate to a least-privilege workflow (ephemeral grants).

oliver-ng: I can do a temporary grant. command I will run:
```
# grant decrypter for 2 hours
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/sast-keys/cryptoKeys/fixtures-key \
  --member=serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
# then schedule revoke via cloud scheduler job
```

maria-chen: can we also suppress the SAST finding if it's proven to be an encrypted fixture? need a short-term suppression to avoid noise while infra fixes perms.

josh-keller: agreed. proposal: add a CI suppression rule that excludes files matching pkg/**/testdata/*.enc and mark suppression with evidence link to the audit log entry. suppression TTL 7 days.

ashley: I'll owner the triage:
- verify hole is FP (ashley)
- request temp grant (oliver)
- add CI suppression (maria)
- create postmortem and update RBAC playbook (josh)

ashley: creating internal ticket now: ENGSEC-4721. adding links + evidence.

sec-oncall: please make sure we capture audit log IDs and sequence numbers so compliance can verify. Also include the rotation/change PR number.

oliver-ng: granted temporary decrypt role. audit id: audit-log-20260320-230211. temporary grant expires 2026-03-21T12:00:00Z.

maria-chen: suppression rule added to CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/suppressions/ENGSEC-4721 — will only suppress matches in testdata/*.enc and requires manual review to remove.

josh-keller: merging unblock checklist:
- scanner can decrypt fixtures (verified) ✅
- SAST rerun shows no high on pkg/credentials ✅
- temporary grant scheduled for revoke ✅
- suppression in place with audit link ✅

ashley: leaving follow-ups for postmortem: update RBAC change runbook to include pre-change scan of dependent service accounts, and add automated test that the scanner SA can access KMS keys used in CI.

maria-chen: thanks all. closing the immediate blocker. will attach a short writeup in ENGSEC-4721. :thumbsup:

sec-oncall: note: if any other scanners depend on the same key, include them in the audit and re-evaluate key scoping.

ashley: will do. assigned to @ashley for postmortem draft by EOD tomorrow.

josh-keller: also adding a short-term improvement ticket: infra should adopt ephemeral IAM grants via short-lived tokens for scanner job rather than static SA perms.

maria-chen: OK moving this thread to resolved. ping if anything else regresses.
